title: Business explained
description: E-commerce giant Flipkart is entering the food delivery market using the government-backed ONDC network. This means you might soon order food from a new app c.

faq.q: How can I start using ONDC for food delivery?
faq.a: Once Flipkart launches its dedicated food delivery app, you can download it and use it like any other food ordering app. You can also use other ONDC-enabled buyer apps like Paytm or PhonePe's Pincode to find restaurants on the network.

faq.q: Do restaurants need to join a specific app to sell on ONDC?
faq.a: Restaurants need to register with a "seller app" that is part of the ONDC network. Once they do, their menu becomes visible to customers using any "buyer app" connected to ONDC.
ONDC is an initiative by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Government of India. It is led by a private non-profit Section 8 company.

faq.q: How many businesses are currently on ONDC?
faq.a: As of April 2026, over 7 lakh (700,000) sellers and service providers have onboarded ONDC, operating in more than 1,200 cities. The network has facilitated over 450 million cumulative transactions as of June 2026.
